resources.string: Show the name and avatar of blocked users in the blocked users list
Subscribe to room sync when a push is received
Exclude insecure devices when sending/receiving messages

This setting controls how end-to-end encryption (E2E) keys are shared. Enabling it will prevent the inclusion of devices that have not been explicitly verified by their owners. You\'ll have to stop and re-open the app manually for that setting to take effect.
Allow creating rooms which users can request access to.

Print logs to logcat in addition to log files. Requires an app restart to take effect.\n\nWARNING: this will make the logs visible in the device logs and may affect performance. It\'s not intended for daily usage in release builds.
You can select the media quality for each attachment you upload.
Renders thread messages as a dedicated timeline. Restarting the app is required for this setting to fully take effect.
Allow the application to connect to multiple accounts at the same time.\n\nWARNING: this feature is EXPERIMENTAL and UNSTABLE.
Allow logging in on other devices using a QR code.
Allow selecting the black appearance theme for battery saving on OLED.
Validate internet connectivity when scheduling notification fetching
Only fetch events for push notifications when the device has internet connectivity. Enabling this can be problematic in air-gapped environments.
Show a button to jump to the read marker, plus a count badge on the scroll-to-bottom button when new messages arrive while scrolled away.
Parse slash commands in the message composer
Allow parsing slash commands in the message composer and perform action.
Add a list of threads in a room
Add a new screen with a list of threads in a room.
Allow the app to automatically back paginate in rooms to pre-fetch older messages in background.\nRequires an app restart to take effect.
Show the number of unread messages on the unread indicator in the room list.
Allow sending multiple media items in a single message.
Index messages locally so they can be searched. Only messages received while enabled are indexed.
Enable trace logs per SDK feature
